text: _Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid, for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
zh: _看哪，上帝是我的拯救；我要信靠，不再惧怕，因为主耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌；他也成为我的救赎。
chunks: _Behold, God is my salvation;
I will trust and not be afraid,
for the Lord Jehovah is my strength
and my song;
he also is become my salvation.

text: It is therefore, I confess, not a little hazardous in a private and obscure individual, and a stranger too, thus to solicit the indulgent attention of the public; especially when I own I offer here the history of neither a saint, a hero, nor a tyrant.
chunks: It is therefore, I confess, not a little hazardous
in a private and obscure individual, and a stranger too,
thus to solicit the indulgent attention of the public;
especially when I own I offer here the history
of neither a saint, a hero, nor a tyrant.

text: Let it therefore be remembered, that, in wishing to avoid censure, I do not aspire to praise.
zh: 因此请记住，为了避免谴责，我并不渴望赞扬。
chunks: Let it therefore be remembered, that,
in wishing
to avoid censure,
I do not aspire
to praise.

text: My father was one of those elders or chiefs I have spoken of, and was styled Embrenche; a term, as I remember, importing the highest distinction, and signifying in our language a _mark_ of grandeur.
zh: 我的父亲是我提到过的那些长老或酋长之一，他的绰号是“Embrenche”。我记得，这个词代表着最高的荣誉，在我们的语言中意味着宏伟的标志。
chunks: My father was one of those elders
or chiefs I have spoken of,
and was styled Embrenche; a term, as I remember,
importing the highest distinction, and signifying
in our language a _mark_ of grandeur.

text: The proceedings were generally short; and in most cases the law of retaliation prevailed.
zh: 诉讼程序通常很短；在大多数情况下，报复法占了上风。
chunks: The proceedings were generally short;
and in most cases the law
of retaliation prevailed.

text: The men, however, do not preserve the same constancy to their wives, which they expect from them; for they indulge in a plurality, though seldom in more than two.
chunks: The men, however,
do not preserve the same constancy
to their wives, which they expect from them;
for they indulge in a plurality,
though seldom in more than two.

text: These are offered by the friends of both parties; besides which the parents of the bridegroom present gifts to those of the bride, whose property she is looked upon before marriage; but after it she is esteemed the sole property of her husband.
chunks: These are offered by the friends
of both parties; besides which the parents
of the bridegroom present gifts to those of the bride,
whose property she is looked upon before marriage;
but after it she is esteemed the sole property of her husband.

text: The first division contains the married men, who in their dances frequently exhibit feats of arms, and the representation of a battle.
zh: 第一组由已婚男子组成，他们在舞蹈中经常展示武功和战斗的表现。
chunks: The first division contains the married men,
who in their dances frequently exhibit feats
of arms,
and the representation
of a battle.

text: This gives our dances a spirit and variety which I have scarcely seen elsewhere[B].
zh: 这赋予我们的舞蹈一种我在其他地方几乎没有见过的精神和多样性[B]。
chunks: This gives our dances a spirit
and variety which I have scarcely seen elsewhere[B].

text: The dress of both sexes is nearly the same.
zh: 男女的着装几乎相同。
chunks: The dress
of both sexes is nearly the same.

text: When our women are not employed with the men in tillage, their usual occupation is spinning and weaving cotton, which they afterwards dye, and make it into garments.
zh: 当我们的妇女不与男人一起耕作时，她们通常的工作是纺织棉花，然后将其染色，制成衣服。
chunks: When our women are not employed
with the men in tillage,
their usual occupation is spinning
and weaving cotton, which they afterwards dye,
and make it into garments.

text: These constitute likewise the principal wealth of the country, and the chief articles of its commerce.
zh: 这些同样构成了国家的主要财富及其商业的主要物品。
chunks: These constitute likewise the principal wealth
of the country,
and the chief articles
of its commerce.

text: After washing, libation is made, by pouring out a small portion of the food, in a certain place, for the spirits of departed relations, which the natives suppose to preside over their conduct, and guard them from evil.
zh: 洗净后，将一小部分食物倒在某个地方，为已故亲人的灵魂举行奠酒，当地人认为这些灵魂可以主持他们的行为，并保护他们免受邪恶的侵害。
chunks: After washing, libation is made, by pouring out a small portion
of the food, in a certain place,
for the spirits of departed relations,
which the natives suppose to preside over their conduct,
and guard them from evil.

text: The same tree also produces nuts and oil.
zh: 同一棵树还生产坚果和油。
chunks: The same tree also produces nuts
and oil.

text: Within this are his houses to accommodate his family and slaves; which, if numerous, frequently present the appearance of a village.
chunks: Within this are his houses
to accommodate his family
and slaves; which, if numerous,
frequently present the appearance
of a village.

text: The habitations of the slaves and their families are distributed throughout the rest of the enclosure.
zh: 奴隶及其家人的住所分布在围栏的其余部分。
chunks: The habitations
of the slaves and their families are distributed throughout the rest of the enclosure.

text: The walls and floors also of these are generally covered with mats.
zh: 这些的墙壁和地板通常也覆盖有垫子。
chunks: The walls
and floors also of these are generally covered with mats.

text: Every man is a sufficient architect for the purpose.
zh: 每个人都是达到这一目的的充分建筑师。
chunks: Every man is a sufficient architect
for the purpose.

text: But these make no part of our commerce, the principal articles of which, as I have observed, are provisions.
zh: 但这些并不构成我们商业的一部分，正如我所观察到的，我们商业的主要条款是规定。
chunks: But these make no part
of our commerce,
the principal articles of which,
as I have observed,
are provisions.

text: They generally bring us fire-arms, gunpowder, hats, beads, and dried fish.
zh: 他们通常给我们带来枪支、火药、帽子、珠子和鱼干。
chunks: They generally bring us fire-arms, gunpowder, hats,
beads,
and dried fish.

text: Sometimes indeed we sold slaves to them, but they were only prisoners of war, or such among us as had been convicted of kidnapping, or adultery, and some other crimes, which we esteemed heinous.
zh: 有时我们确实向他们出售奴隶，但他们只是战俘，或者是我们当中因绑架、通奸和其他一些我们认为令人发指的罪行而被定罪的人。
chunks: Sometimes indeed we sold slaves to them,
but they were only prisoners
of war, or such among us
as had been convicted of kidnapping, or adultery,
and some other crimes, which we esteemed heinous.

text: Our pine apples grow without culture; they are about the size of the largest sugar-loaf, and finely flavoured.
zh: 我们的菠萝是在没有栽培的情况下生长的；它们的大小与最大的糖面包差不多，味道细腻。
chunks: Our pine apples grow
without culture; they are
about the size
of the largest sugar-loaf,
and finely flavoured.

text: Thus we are all habituated to labour from our earliest years.
zh: 因此，我们从小就习惯于劳动。
chunks: Thus we are all habituated
to labour from our earliest years.

text: Deformity is indeed unknown amongst us, I mean that of shape.
zh: 畸形对于我们来说确实是未知的，我指的是形状。
chunks: Deformity is indeed unknown amongst us,
I mean
that of shape.

text: They are also remarkably cheerful.
zh: 他们也非常开朗。
chunks: They are also
remarkably cheerful.

text: Sometimes we are visited by locusts, which come in large clouds, so as to darken the air, and destroy our harvest.
zh: 有时，我们会遇到蝗虫，它们成群结队地飞来，使空气变暗，破坏我们的收成。
chunks: Sometimes we are visited
by locusts, which come
in large clouds, so as
to darken the air,
and destroy our harvest.

text: Such a mode of obtaining slaves in Africa is common; and I believe more are procured this way, and by kidnapping, than any other[E].
zh: 这种获取奴隶的方式在非洲很常见；我相信通过这种方式和绑架获得的东西比任何其他方式都多[E]。
chunks: Such a mode of obtaining slaves
in Africa is common;
and I believe more are procured this way,
and by kidnapping,
than any other[E].

text: We have fire-arms, bows and arrows, broad two-edged swords and javelins: we have shields also which cover a man from head to foot.
zh: 我们有火器、弓箭、宽阔的两刃剑和标枪；我们还有盾牌，把人从头到脚都罩起来。
chunks: We have fire-arms, bows and arrows,
broad two-edged swords and javelins:
we have shields also
which cover a man
from head to foot.

text: We had been all at work in it one day as usual, when our people were suddenly attacked.
zh: 有一天，我们像往常一样在工作，我们的人突然遭到袭击。
chunks: We had been all
at work
in it one day
as usual,
when our people were suddenly attacked.

text: He was carried off in great triumph, and, though he offered a large ransom for his life, he was put to death.
zh: 他在巨大的胜利中被带走，尽管他付出了大笔赎金，但他还是被处死了。
chunks: He was carried
off in great triumph, and,
though he offered a large ransom
for his life,
he was put to death.

text: As to religion, the natives believe that there is one Creator of all things, and that he lives in the sun, and is girted round with a belt that he may never eat or drink; but, according to some, he smokes a pipe, which is our own favourite luxury.
chunks: As to religion, the natives believe that there is one Creator
of all things, and that he lives in the sun, and is girted round
with a belt that he may never eat
or drink; but, according to some, he smokes a pipe,
which is our own favourite luxury.

text: I was very fond of my mother, and almost constantly with her.
zh: 我非常喜欢我的母亲，几乎一直和她在一起。
chunks: I was very fond
of my mother,
and almost constantly
with her.

text: The loneliness of the place, the darkness of the night, and the ceremony of libation, naturally awful and gloomy, were heightened by my mother's lamentations; and these, concuring with the cries of doleful birds, by which these places were frequented, gave an inexpressible terror to the scene.
chunks: The loneliness of the place, the darkness of the night,
and the ceremony of libation, naturally awful
and gloomy, were heightened by my mother's lamentations; and these,
concuring with the cries of doleful birds, by which these places were frequented,
gave an inexpressible terror to the scene.

text: They have many offerings, particularly at full moons; generally two at harvest before the fruits are taken out of the ground: and when any young animals are killed, sometimes they offer up part of them as a sacrifice.
zh: 他们有很多供品，尤其是在满月时；通常在收获时两次，然后将果实从地里取出：当任何幼小的动物被杀死时，有时他们会提供一部分作为祭品。
chunks: They have many offerings, particularly at full moons;
generally two at harvest before the fruits are taken
out of the ground:
and when any young animals are killed,
sometimes they offer up part of them as a sacrifice.

text: We had a saying among us to any one of a cross temper, 'That if they were to be eaten, they should be eaten with bitter herbs.
zh: 我们中间对脾气暴躁的人有一句话：“如果要吃它们，就应该和苦菜一起吃。
chunks: We had a saying
among us to any one
of a cross temper,
'That if they were to be eaten,
they should be eaten with bitter herbs.

text: The only expressions of that kind I remember were 'May you rot, or may you swell, or may a beast take you.
chunks: The only expressions
of that kind I remember were 'May you rot,
or may you swell,
or may a beast take you.

text: Every woman too, at certain times, was forbidden to come into a dwelling-house, or touch any person, or any thing we ate.
zh: 每个女人在某些时候也被禁止进入住宅，或触摸任何人或我们吃的任何东西。
chunks: Every woman too, at certain times,
was forbidden to come
into a dwelling-house,
or touch any person,
or any thing we ate.

text: They wore their beards, and when they died they were succeeded by their sons.
zh: 他们留着胡须，死后由他们的儿子继任。
chunks: They wore their beards,
and when they died they were succeeded
by their sons.

text: These buried them after sunset, and always returned from the grave by a different way from that which they went.
zh: 他们在日落后埋葬他们，并且总是以与他们去时不同的方式从坟墓返回。
chunks: These buried them after sunset,
and always returned
from the grave
by a different way
from that which they went.

text: I do not remember what those methods were, except that as to poisoning: I recollect an instance or two, which I hope it will not be deemed impertinent here to insert, as it may serve as a kind of specimen of the rest, and is still used by the negroes in the West Indies.
chunks: I do not remember what those methods were,
except that as to poisoning: I recollect an instance or two,
which I hope it will not be deemed impertinent here
to insert, as it may serve as a kind of specimen
of the rest, and is still used by the negroes in the West Indies.

text: When they buy any eatable the seller kisses it all round before the buyer, to shew him it is not poisoned; and the same is done when any meat or drink is presented, particularly to a stranger.
zh: 当他们购买任何食物时，卖家会在买家面前亲吻它的周围，以表明它没有中毒；当提供任何肉类或饮料时，尤其是向陌生人时，也会这样做。
chunks: When they buy any eatable the seller kisses it all round
before the buyer, to shew him it is not poisoned;
and the same is done
when any meat or drink is presented,
particularly to a stranger.

text: Such is the imperfect sketch my memory has furnished me with of the manners and customs of a people among whom I first drew my breath.
zh: 这就是我的记忆为我提供的关于一个我第一次接触到的民族的风俗习惯的不完美的草图。
chunks: Such is the imperfect sketch my memory has furnished me
with of the manners
and customs
of a people
among whom I first drew my breath.

text: Israelites in their primitive state, our government was conducted by our chiefs or judges, our wise men and elders; and the head of a family with us enjoyed a similar authority over his household with that which is ascribed to Abraham and the other patriarchs.
chunks: Israelites in their primitive state, our government was conducted
by our chiefs or judges, our wise men and elders;
and the head of a family
with us enjoyed a similar authority over his household with that
which is ascribed to Abraham and the other patriarchs.

text: Human Species, has ascertained the cause, in a manner that at once solves every objection on that account, and, on my mind at least, has produced the fullest conviction.
zh: 人类已经查明了原因，其方式立即解决了所有对此问题的反对意见，并且至少在我看来，已经产生了最充分的信念。
chunks: Human Species, has ascertained the cause, in a manner
that at once solves every objection
on that account, and,
on my mind at least,
has produced the fullest conviction.

text: Are there not causes enough to which the apparent inferiority of an African may be ascribed, without limiting the goodness of God, and supposing he forbore to stamp understanding on certainly his own image, because "carved in ebony.
zh: 难道没有足够的理由可以将非洲人的明显劣等归咎于上帝的善良，假设他克制自己的形象，因为“雕刻在乌木上”，所以没有限制上帝的善良。
chunks: Are there not causes enough to which the apparent inferiority
of an African may be ascribed,
without limiting the goodness of God,
and supposing he forbore to stamp understanding
on certainly his own image, because "carved in ebony.

text: Are they treated as men?
zh: 他们被当作男人对待吗？
chunks: Are they treated
as men?

text: Every rational mind answers, No.
zh: 每个理性的头脑都会回答：不。
chunks: Every rational mind
answers, No.

text: [Footnote F: See also Leut.
zh: [脚注 F：另见 Leut。
chunks: [Footnote F:
See also Leut.

text: The mate therefore desired two of the sailors to take up the coffin, and carry it to the grave.
zh: 因此，大副希望两名水手抬起棺材，并将其带到坟墓。
chunks: The mate therefore desired two
of the sailors
to take up the coffin,
and carry it
to the grave.

text: [Footnote K: Acts, c. xvii. v.
zh: [脚注 K：使徒行传，c.十七. v.
chunks: [Footnote K: Acts,
c. xvii. v.

text: As I was the youngest of the sons, I became, of course, the greatest favourite with my mother, and was always with her; and she used to take particular pains to form my mind.
chunks: As I was the youngest
of the sons, I became, of course,
the greatest favourite with my mother, and was always with her;
and she used to take particular pains
to form my mind.

text: Here they tied our hands, and continued to carry us as far as they could, till night came on, when we reached a small house, where the robbers halted for refreshment, and spent the night.
zh: 他们在这里绑住我们的手，继续把我们抬到尽可能远的地方，直到夜幕降临，我们到达一所小房子，强盗们停下来吃点东西，然后过夜。
chunks: Here they tied our hands, and continued to carry us
as far as they could, till night came on,
when we reached a small house,
where the robbers halted for refreshment,
and spent the night.

text: I had now some hopes of being delivered; for we had advanced but a little way before I discovered some people at a distance, on which I began to cry out for their assistance: but my cries had no other effect than to make them tie me faster and stop my mouth, and then they put me into a large sack.
chunks: I had now some hopes of being delivered; for we had advanced but a little way
before I discovered some people at a distance,
on which I began to cry out for their assistance:
but my cries had no other effect than to make them tie me faster
and stop my mouth, and then they put me into a large sack.

text: It was in vain that we besought them not to part us; she was torn from me, and immediately carried away, while I was left in a state of distraction not to be described.
chunks: It was in vain
that we besought them not to part us;
she was torn from me,
and immediately carried away, while I was left
in a state of distraction not to be described.

text: Although I was a great many days journey from my father's house, yet these people spoke exactly the same language with us.
chunks: Although I was a great many days journey
from my father's house,
yet these people spoke exactly the same language
with us.

text: I was there I suppose about a month, and they at last used to trust me some little distance from the house.
chunks: I was there I suppose
about a month, and they
at last used
to trust me some little distance
from the house.

text: This alarmed me very much, and I expected an instant flogging, which to me was uncommonly dreadful; for I had seldom been beaten at home.
chunks: This alarmed me very much,
and I expected an instant flogging,
which to me was uncommonly dreadful;
for I had seldom been beaten
at home.

text: The neighbours continued the whole day looking for me, and several times many of them came within a few yards of the place where I lay hid.
chunks: The neighbours continued the whole day looking
for me, and several times many
of them came within a few yards
of the place
where I lay hid.

text: I heard frequent rustlings among the leaves; and being pretty sure they were snakes I expected every instant to be stung by them.
chunks: I heard frequent rustlings
among the leaves;
and being pretty sure they were snakes I expected every instant
to be stung
by them.

text: She was very much surprised to see me, and could scarcely believe her own eyes.
chunks: She was very much surprised
to see me,
and could scarcely believe her own eyes.

text: The people I was sold to used to carry me very often, when I was tired, either on their shoulders or on their backs.
chunks: The people I was sold to used
to carry me very often,
when I was tired,
either on their shoulders
or on their backs.

text: They were therefore easily learned; and, while I was journeying thus through Africa, I acquired two or three different tongues.
chunks: They were therefore easily learned; and,
while I was journeying thus
through Africa,
I acquired two
or three different tongues.

text: The small relief which her presence gave me from pain was gone, and the wretchedness of my situation was redoubled by my anxiety after her fate, and my apprehensions lest her sufferings should be greater than mine, when I could not be with her to alleviate them.
chunks: The small relief which her presence gave me
from pain was gone, and the wretchedness
of my situation was redoubled by my anxiety after her fate,
and my apprehensions lest her sufferings should be greater
than mine, when I could not be with her to alleviate them.

text: I was again sold, and carried through a number of places, till, after travelling a considerable time, I came to a town called Tinmah, in the most beautiful country I have yet seen in Africa.
chunks: I was again sold,
and carried through a number of places, till,
after travelling a considerable time, I came
to a town called Tinmah,
in the most beautiful country I have yet seen in Africa.
